derivation: A DAG joint density has one local probability factor per node. The inline SVG contains x1,x2,x3,x4,x5.
Trace the SVG endpoint geometry and caption: x1->x3, x2->x3, x5->x2, x2->x4.
Collect incoming arrows: x1 none; x2 from x5; x3 from x1 and x2; x4 from x2; x5 none.
checks: Inline line/polyline arrowheads agree with the supplied caption and accessibility label.

derivation: Only x2 has an arrow into x4. The local factor conditions on all and only the represented parents.
checks: One local scalar probability/density factor per node value.

derivation: Read the same supplied arrow set: x1->x3, x2->x3, x5->x2, x2->x4.
Root factors are p(x1),p(x5); nonroots give p(x2|x5),p(x3|x1,x2),p(x4|x2). Multiply these five factors.
checks: Five local factors, one per node.
If each local distribution is normalized, summing/integrating leaves x3,x4 first, then x2, then roots yields total mass 1.

derivation: Let B2 mean bag 2 and M mean mango. P(B1)=3/5,P(B2)=2/5; P(M|B1)=4/6=2/3; P(M|B2)=4/8=1/2.
checks: The two disjoint mango paths sum to 3/5>0.
Posterior bag1 probability 2/3 plus bag2 1/3 equals 1.

derivation: Under the finite-expectation condition integral integral |x| p(x,y) dx dy<infinity, conditional expectation is integrable and Fubini applies.
E_Y[E_X[X|Y]]=integral p_Y(y)[integral x p(x|y) dx]dy = integral integral x p(x,y) dx dy.
For p_Y(y)=0 choose any conditional version, since its contribution is zero. Swap order by absolute integrability and use integral p(x,y)dy=p_X(x).
The result is integral x p_X(x)dx=E_X[X].
subparts.conclusion: E_X[X]=E_Y[E_X[X|Y]] whenever X is integrable; the law also extends to nonnegative X in the extended-value sense.
checks: Normalization alone does not ensure signed expectations exist; no unjustified exchange of divergent integrals.
unresolved: The packet does not explicitly assume E|X|<infinity or nonnegative X. For arbitrary signed nonintegrable X the displayed expectations may be undefined, so the universal claim needs an existence/integrability condition.
